note: DNA OS is AI-agnostic — it is not locked to any single AI vendor. Any agent that satisfies compatibility_contract is DNA OS Compatible, whether or not it appears in agents[] below. This list is a directory of agents known to have worked on or been evaluated against this repo, not a whitelist or a gate. A new AI does not need to be added here first — it only needs to follow registry/README.md.
